subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II bridge letter to cover post-report period
messages:
From: Elena Morales <security@nimbushealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 bridge letter request for Nimbus Health vendor review

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this — Nimbus is running a security review for an upcoming pilot and we need a bridge letter to cover the gap between your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and the present date. Our procurement deadline is 12/18.

Specifically we need:
- A bridge letter (signed) that attests there have been no changes to controls that would materially affect the SOC 2 report since the report period ended on 2024-07-31.
- Confirmation of the current report end date and the audit period covered by the attached SOC 2 report (we only have a July 2024 cover page right now).
- If possible, a brief statement that no security incidents impacting customer data have occurred since the report end date, or an explanation if there were any.

Can you share the SOC 2 Type II report and a draft bridge letter? Also let us know who at Redwood will sign. We may route this to legal/security but want to get a draft in the queue.

Thanks —
Elena Morales
Senior Security Analyst, Nimbus Health
security@nimbushealth.com

Attachment: nimbus-security-questionnaire.xlsx (reference)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <security@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Bowers <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 bridge letter request for Nimbus Health vendor review

Hi Elena (and Tom),

Thanks for the note — happy to help. I am looping in Markus (Head of Security) and Stephanie (Legal ops) to prepare the formal materials.

Quick answers up front:
- Our latest SOC 2 Type II report covers the audit period 2023-08-01 through 2024-07-31; I will attach the full report.
- We can provide a signed bridge letter that confirms there have been no material control changes since 2024-07-31 and provides an incident statement.

Markus/Stephanie — can you please: 1) confirm the exact wording we should provide for the bridge letter; 2) confirm who will sign (we typically have VP Security sign these); and 3) attach the draft for Nimbus review. Elena — any required language your controls team needs beyond what you described?

I’ll aim to get the draft to you by EOD Friday (12/05).

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Report_202407.pdf (full report)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <security@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Bowers <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Draft bridge letter and supplemental evidence

Hi all,

Attached is a draft bridge letter we commonly provide for post-report coverage; it references our SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 31 Jul 2024) and contains the standard attestations:
- No material changes to the control environment affecting the Trust Services Criteria since the report period end.
- No material security incidents affecting customer data to date.

We are prepared to have our VP of Security sign the finalized letter. If Nimbus requires a corporate officer signature instead, let us know and we will route accordingly.

Also attached: a redacted incident log summary for the period 2025-07 through 2025-11; it contains no entries classified as "security incidents impacting customer data." If you prefer, we can provide additional evidence (change logs, patching reports, SOC monitoring extracts) under an NDA or secure transfer.

Next steps: Elena — please review the draft and indicate any required modifications; we can incorporate redlines and return a final PDF for signature via DocuSign.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_bridge_letter_draft_20251205.pdf; Redwood_incident_log_summary_202507-202511.csv

From: Elena Morales <security@nimbushealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bowers <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Dec 2025 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft bridge letter and supplemental evidence

Thanks Markus — the draft looks good overall. A few small requests from our security team:
1) Please add explicit language: "As of the date of this letter, Redwood Inference confirms that no security incidents have occurred since 2024-07-31 that materially affected the security, availability, or confidentiality of customer data."
2) Can you confirm the signatory: we need the signer to be an officer with security accountability (VP Security is acceptable). Please include the signer's printed name and title in the letter.
3) Would you include a short statement clarifying the audit firm's name that performed the SOC 2 Type II review (so our records can match the auditor).

Also, for procurement: can you provide Redwood's EIN and the name to appear on the certificate of insurance? Tom, if you need anything else from procurement side let us know.

If you can incorporate the three items and send back an updated PDF we can route for approval internally and get the DocuSign request ready.

Best,
Elena

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <security@nimbushealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2025 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft bridge letter and supplemental evidence

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick review.

We will incorporate your requested wording and add the auditor name (Brightline Audit LLC) and the signatory block for our VP of Security, Markus Klein. For procurement items: Redwood Inference EIN: 27-3141592; Certificate of Insurance name: Redwood Inference, Inc.

Markus — can you confirm you'll sign and we'll route via DocuSign? We aim to have the signed letter back to Nimbus within 48 hours after the final PDF is accepted.

Rachel — I cc'd you for visibility on timelines for the procurement team.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Elena Morales <security@nimbushealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 15:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft bridge letter and supplemental evidence

Perfect — that covers everything we need. Please finalize and send via DocuSign to the email below (procurement@nimbushealth.com) when ready.

We appreciate the quick turnaround; once we have the signed bridge letter and a copy of the SOC 2 report auditor name we can move the pilot procurement forward.

Thanks again,
Elena Morales
Senior Security Analyst, Nimbus Health
security@nimbushealth.com

DocuSign request placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/req/ZXcvbnm-bridge-2025
